assessments.reasoning: The two inspected ranges cover the exact file at Archive commit 23fb4bfec24351cd6bdc74d4e08f538bcb721e99. The common digest matches the claim. Its LICENSE section directly supplies both the later-version option and the distinct configure-output permission.

SPDX’s pinned text supports the exception portion and cites AX_PTHREAD. Its reference to GPL has no version qualifier. That is consistent with the file supplying the separate version declaration and leaves SPDX insufficient on its own to select a base.

challenge.method: Tested GPL-3.0-only, the older Autoconf driver’s GPL-2.0-or-later notice, and an inference from the version-neutral SPDX macro exception. Also checked whether sharing a base target ID with the standalone claim erased the variant.
challenge.results: The file’s express election rules out the first two readings. The SPDX macro text leaves the version unspecified. The shared target ID cannot encode the distinction by itself. This relationship’s scope preserves the later-version option, while the standalone document identifies the GPLv3 edition.

limitations: GPL-3.0-or-later is the variant declared in this revision of AX_PTHREAD. The result supplies no base-version finding for xorg-macros, xmltooling or other Archive files. The supplied evidence verifies the documentary scope but does not separately resolve the opaque registry target.
